f1-001.alert: Safety Car deployed! Latifi crashes with 5 laps to go
f1-001.why: Erases Hamilton's 12s lead and flips pit strategy for the championship finale.
f1-001.novice_note: A Safety Car slows everyone down and packs the grid together, eliminating any lead.

f1-002.alert: Verstappen pits for Soft tyres! Hamilton stays out
f1-002.why: Red Bull gambles on fresh rubber; Hamilton left vulnerable on worn hard tyres.
f1-002.novice_note: Soft tyres give immense grip and speed over short sprints compared to worn hard tyres.

cric-001.alert: Klaasen reaches 50 off 23 balls, SA cruising
cric-001.why: Fast fifty keeps SA in control needing 26 off 24, but no sudden match swing.
cric-001.novice_note: A half-century is 50 runs scored by one batter, a significant personal milestone.

cric-002.alert: Klaasen falls for 52! SA 151/5, 26 needed off 23
cric-002.why: Dangerous set batter dismissed just as SA looked certain to cruise home.
cric-002.novice_note: Losing a set batter right at the death shifts immense pressure onto incoming batters.

ten-005.alert: Break point for Sinner at 3-2 in 5th set decider
ten-005.why: Crucial opening to take control of the championship set on Medvedev's serve.
ten-005.novice_note: A break point allows the receiver to win the opponent's service game and gain a huge lead.

ten-006.alert: Sinner breaks Medvedev! Leads 4-2 in 5th set
ten-006.why: Decisive break in the final set gives Sinner a clear path to his first Grand Slam.
ten-006.novice_note: Breaking serve in a decider is often the winning moment in a Grand Slam final.

cric-004.alert: Bumrah castles Jansen! SA 157/6, 20 needed off 14
cric-004.why: Bumrah's lethal off-cutter exposes the tail and pushes required rate over 9.
cric-004.novice_note: Hitting the stumps directly (bowled) gives the batter zero chance of survival.

f1-004.alert: Lapped cars cleared between Hamilton and Verstappen
f1-004.why: Race Control decision clears obstacles for a direct final-lap title battle.
f1-004.novice_note: Lapped cars are slower cars a lap down; moving them creates an unobstructed duel.

f1-005.alert: Safety Car in! One-lap sprint for the World Title
f1-005.why: Hamilton on dead hards vs Verstappen on fresh softs for one lap to decide the year.
f1-005.novice_note: The Safety Car leaves the track, and racing resumes immediately at full speed.

cric-005.alert: SURYAKUMAR YADAV CATCH! Miller gone for 21!
cric-005.why: Incredible boundary juggling catch seals the World Cup on the first ball of over 20.
cric-005.novice_note: Catching inside the boundary rope without touching it sends the dangerous finisher back.

f1-006.alert: VERSTAPPEN OVERTAKES HAMILTON ON FINAL LAP!
f1-006.why: Turn 5 dive down the inside secures the lead and the 2021 World Drivers' Championship.
f1-006.novice_note: An overtake on the final lap directly decides who wins the race and title.

cric-006.alert: Rabada hits four! SA needs 8 off 2 balls
cric-006.why: Boundary keeps mathematical chance alive, but India still has the upper hand.
cric-006.novice_note: A four reduces the target, but requiring four runs per ball remains very difficult.

cric-007.alert: INDIA WINS T20 WORLD CUP BY 7 RUNS!
cric-007.why: Hardik Pandya seals victory on the final ball, ending India's 11-year ICC trophy drought.
cric-007.novice_note: The defending team restricts the batting team below the target, winning the match.

ten-008.alert: Championship point for Jannik Sinner at 40-30!
ten-008.why: One point away from winning his first Grand Slam title after trailing by two sets.
ten-008.novice_note: Championship point means winning this single point awards the player the tournament trophy.

ten-009.why: Completes historic 5-set comeback from 0-2 down to claim maiden Grand Slam title.
ten-009.novice_note: Winning three out of five sets secures the Grand Slam championship.
